Previously, archiving or requeuing a session while a hook was running, or stopping the runner, left the hook's process running and kept the runner's slot occupied. This has been fixed. With `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` enabled, `.claude/settings.local.json` left over from a previous session is also no longer mistakenly committed to version control. When creating certificate files for Anthropic-managed Git, the runner now filters trusted certificates the same way as the CLI and logs the number excluded with `[runner:warn]`.

items.original:
Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` committing a `.claude/settings.local.json` left in the clone by an earlier session
Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session, or stopping the runner, during its checkout hook leaving the hook's processes running and the runner's slot held
Self-hosted runner: Changed checkout hooks to be stopped after 30 minutes by default, failing the session's setup; if yours needs longer, raise `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` or set it to `0`
Self-hosted runner: Changed the certificate file built for Anthropic-managed git to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does; a `[runner:warn]` line gives the number left out

title.zh-TW: VS Code 限制展開提示詞高度，修正 LaTeX 數學式貼上格式
title.en: VS Code limits expanded prompt height and fixes pasted LaTeX formatting

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 中使用 Claude Code 撰寫複雜指示或整理筆記時，對話框排版與文字貼上體驗更為順暢。過去只要點擊 Show more 展開較長的提示詞，整張輸入卡片會直接霸佔整個對話面板；現在釘選的提示詞高度被限制在面板的 40% 以內，超出範圍時會自動產生捲軸方便上下滾動。當你複製含有 LaTeX 數學式的清單項目或表格儲存格時，貼進富文字編輯器中不會再被錯誤切碎成全新的清單或表格。遇到擴充套件重啟後殘留的 Claude 背景行程時，「仍在其他地方開啟」的提示視窗現在也能清楚識別，並說明該行程通常在約 10 分鐘內便會自行退出。以前長文字一展開就遮蔽對話歷史、貼上公式格式又容易碎裂，現在排版邊界更穩定，編輯與查閱操作不再互相打架。
body.en: Writing complex instructions or organizing notes with Claude Code in VS Code now feels smoother, with better conversation layouts and text pasting. Previously, clicking Show more to expand a long prompt made the entire input card take over the conversation panel. Pinned prompts are now limited to 40% of the panel’s height, with a scrollbar appearing automatically when the content exceeds that limit. When you copy list items or table cells containing LaTeX equations into a rich text editor, they no longer get incorrectly split into new lists or tables. The “still open somewhere else” notice now clearly identifies Claude background processes left over after an extension restart and explains that they usually exit on their own within about 10 minutes. Previously, expanding long text obscured the conversation history, and pasting equations could break their formatting. With more stable layout boundaries, editing and reviewing no longer get in each other’s way.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed a long prompt expanded with Show more covering the whole chat panel: a pinned prompt is now capped at 40% of the panel and scrolls
[VSCode] Fixed part of a list item or table cell with LaTeX math pasting as a new list or table in rich text editors
[VSCode] Changed the "still open somewhere else" notice to also cover a Claude process left over from an extension restart, which usually ends on its own within about 10 minutes

title.zh-TW: VS Code 語音聽寫新增中斷提示，完善 TLS 憑證支援
title.en: VS Code voice dictation adds stop explanations and improves TLS certificate support

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 裡對著麥克風念出程式碼需求時，自動停止的機制與公司內網憑證相容性已經獲得完善。當語音聽寫因連續 15 秒沒有辨識出語音或達到 2 分鐘上限而自動關閉時，麥克風按鈕會跳出說明告知原因，並確認剛才說過的文字皆已妥善保留。針對經 TLS 封包檢查的代理網路，若僅在 `~/.claude/settings.json` 設定 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 曾導致聽寫連線失敗，現在已修好，聽寫也會遵循 `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`。語音聽寫與擴充套件本身的請求，現在都比照 CLI 過濾受信任憑證。擴充套件本身的請求也會信任環境變數或使用者設定指定的 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 憑證檔案。
body.en: When you dictate coding requirements into a microphone in VS Code, automatic stopping and compatibility with corporate network certificates now work more reliably. If voice dictation stops automatically after 15 consecutive seconds without recognized speech or upon reaching the 2-minute limit, the microphone button displays an explanation and confirms that everything you dictated has been preserved. On proxy networks with TLS inspection, setting `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` only in `~/.claude/settings.json` could cause dictation connections to fail. This is now fixed, and dictation also follows `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`. Voice dictation and the extension’s own requests now filter trusted certificates the same way the CLI does. The extension’s own requests also trust the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` certificate file specified through environment variables or user settings.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a notice on the microphone button when voice dictation stops by itself (15 seconds without recognized speech, or the 2-minute limit), saying why and that the text so far is kept
[VSCode] Fixed dictation failing behind a TLS-inspecting proxy when `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` is set only in `~/.claude/settings.json`; it now also follows `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`
[VSCode] Changed voice dictation to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does
[VSCode] Changed the extension's own requests to filter their trusted certificates as the CLI does, and to trust the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` file named in the environment or in user settings

title.zh-TW: /presets 新增十組快捷欄位，常用提示詞與指令隨選即用
title.en: /presets adds ten shortcut slots for instant access to frequent prompts and commands

body.zh-TW: 當你反覆在對話中輸入相同的檢查指令或固定提問時，重新打字往往耗費時間。⟦宛若汽車音響上的電台記憶功能，以前想聽固定頻道每次都要手動調頻，現在可以選取已儲存的頻道。⟧現在你可以打 `/presets` 將常用的提示詞與斜線指令儲存到十個編號欄位中。呼叫時還會跳出專屬的鍵盤選單，讓你透過鍵盤快速選取所需的預設項目。例如每次開始整理報告時，就能透過鍵盤選單選取儲存好的審查指令，省去反覆翻找與複製貼上的麻煩。
body.en: When you repeatedly enter the same inspection commands or standard questions during a conversation, retyping them is often time-consuming. ⟦Picture a car radio with station presets, where listening to a favorite channel once required manual tuning each time, but now only takes selecting a saved station.⟧ You can now type `/presets` to store frequently used prompts and slash commands into ten numbered slots. Invoking it brings up a dedicated keyboard menu so you can quickly choose the preset you need. For example, whenever you start compiling a report, you can select a saved review command through the keyboard menu, eliminating the hassle of searching around and copy-pasting.

items.original: Save reusable prompts and slash commands in ten numbered `/presets` slots, with a keyboard menu for quick access. (#54380, #54381)

title.zh-TW: /model 與 /permissions 支援行內參數，單行直接套用設定
title.en: /model and /permissions support inline arguments to apply settings in one command

body.zh-TW: 臨時需要切換模型或調整執行權限時，你可以把要用的設定直接接在指令後面。⟦如同在義式咖啡機直接轉動濃淡旋鈕，以前分開調整的出杯速度與風味濃度，現在點選飲品時順手一扭就能一併指定。⟧現在打 `/model` 或 `/permissions` 時，可以直接在同一行指令接上參數。你能直接在指令後方指定模型名稱、運算速度與推理解題力度（reasoning effort）。如果需要變更授權層級，也可以透過行內參數指定權限設定檔（permission profile）。這讓你輸入一行指令就能立刻切換到所需的執行環境。
body.en: When you need to switch models or adjust execution permissions on the fly, you can append your desired settings directly to the command. ⟦Think of turning a brew strength knob on an espresso machine, where cup speed and flavor intensity once had to be adjusted separately, but now can be set with a quick twist when selecting a beverage.⟧ When typing `/model` or `/permissions`, you can now pass arguments directly on the same line. You can specify the model name, compute speed, and reasoning effort right after the command. If you need to change authorization levels, you can also specify a permission profile through inline arguments. This lets you switch immediately to the required runtime environment with a single command.

items.original: Set model, reasoning effort, speed, and permission profiles directly with inline `/model` and `/permissions` arguments. (#54378, #54383)

title.zh-TW: 支援 Kitty 與 Sixel 協定，全螢幕紀錄直接預覽圖片
title.en: Kitty and Sixel protocols supported to preview images directly in fullscreen logs

body.zh-TW: 在純文字終端機中請 AI 產生或查看圖片時，常常必須切換到外部檢視器才能確認成果。⟦彷彿按下數位相機快門後直接在電子觀景窗回放相片，以前非得把記憶卡插進電腦螢幕才能檢視構圖，現在眼睛不用離開目鏡就能看清影像細節。⟧如果你的終端機支援 Kitty 或 Sixel 圖形協定，現在全螢幕對話紀錄中可以直接預覽圖片。無論是讓工具讀取既有的本機圖檔，或是由模型新產生的圖片，畫面都會直接在紀錄中渲染顯示，不必再特地跳出視窗開啟檔案。
body.en: When asking AI to generate or inspect images in a plain-text terminal, you often have to switch to an external viewer to verify results. ⟦Much like checking a digital camera's electronic viewfinder right after pressing the shutter, where reviewing composition once required plugging a memory card into a computer monitor, you can now inspect image details without taking your eye off the eyepiece.⟧ If your terminal supports the Kitty or Sixel graphics protocol, you can now preview images directly inside fullscreen conversation transcripts. Whether the tool reads an existing local image file or displays a new image generated by the model, the graphic renders directly within the log without opening an external window.

items.original: Preview viewed and generated images in the fullscreen transcript on terminals supporting Kitty or Sixel graphics. (#54216)

title.zh-TW: 企業級 MCP 支援專用登入與帳號授權，納入金鑰用戶端
title.en: Enterprise MCP supports dedicated login and account authorization with secret client access

body.zh-TW: 企業團隊在將內部系統串接至外部工具時，往往受限於嚴格的身分核驗與安全規範。⟦跟持員工證進入特約商務中心一樣，以前訪客通道只能辨識一般識別貼紙，現在閘門不僅支援企業總部的數位權限卡，也能核對附帶安全密鑰的專屬通行條。⟧現在企業級 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）連線支援更多元的驗證方式。你可以使用符合資格的 Codex 帳號授權直接通行，或是使用專屬登入通道完成驗證。對於需要用戶端密鑰（client secret）的 OAuth 用戶端，現在也能順利通過身分確認，安全連接各項企業服務。
body.en: When enterprise teams connect internal systems to external tools, they are often constrained by strict identity verification and security policies. ⟦Just as entering a partner business center with an employee badge once only supported basic visitor decals, the gate now accepts corporate digital access cards as well as dedicated passes with security keys.⟧ Enterprise MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) connections now support more diverse authentication methods. You can authenticate directly using eligible Codex account authorization or complete verification through dedicated login channels. OAuth clients requiring client secrets can now also pass identity verification smoothly and securely connect to various enterprise services.

items.original: Authenticate enterprise MCP connections using eligible Codex account grants or dedicated sign-in, including OAuth clients requiring secrets. (#55334, #55859, #56001)

title.zh-TW: Amazon Bedrock 設定精靈預設啟用，自動整合 AWS 登入方式
title.en: Amazon Bedrock setup wizard enabled by default to integrate AWS login methods

body.zh-TW: 初次在工具中設定雲端模型提供者時，複雜的認證流程常讓人無所適從。⟦好比智慧電視初次開機的引導流程，以前要自己翻出網路線與遙控器代碼手動輸入，現在一開機就自動跳出連線精靈，還會把同品牌的登入選項整合在同一個畫面。⟧現在 Amazon Bedrock 的設定引導精靈改為預設開啟。當系統偵測到環境中的憑證時，API 金鑰輸入選項會自動與其他 AWS 登入方式歸類在同一個區塊，讓你清楚檢視並選取合適的登入途徑，不必再四處尋找設定入口。
body.en: When configuring a cloud model provider in the tool for the first time, complex authentication flows can feel overwhelming. ⟦Consider the initial setup guide of a smart TV, where you once had to find Ethernet cables and enter remote codes manually, but now a setup wizard appears automatically and brings brand login options together on one screen.⟧ The configuration setup wizard for Amazon Bedrock is now enabled by default. When credentials are detected in the environment, the API key input option is automatically grouped into the same section alongside other AWS login methods. This allows you to clearly view and select the appropriate sign-in path without searching around for configuration menus.

items.original: The Amazon Bedrock setup wizard is now enabled by default, with API key entry grouped alongside other AWS sign-in methods when credentials are detected. (#56033, #56023)

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮失敗自動備援，恢復工作階段完整保留討論串設定
title.en: Compaction failures fall back smoothly while resumed sessions preserve thread settings

body.zh-TW: 長時間與 AI 討論累積了大量對話紀錄時，背後的摘要壓縮機制是維持流暢對答的關鍵。⟦就像編輯長篇文件時的自動存檔機制，以前存檔失敗會在草稿夾留下一半的殘缺摘要，重開檔案時個人偏好也被重設成原廠設定；現在即使背景壓縮失敗也會平穩備援，重新開啟時還能精準還原原本的排版。⟧現在對話歷史壓縮（compaction）若不幸失敗，不會再於對話紀錄中留下半截殘缺的摘要內容，背景壓縮失敗時也會安全備援而不引發程式異常崩潰。恢復工作階段（session）時，工具現在能確實找到已壓縮的歷史紀錄，並完整復原原本討論串儲存的設定，而不是擅自將它們覆蓋成全域預設值。
body.en: When extensive discussions with AI accumulate substantial conversation history, the underlying summary compaction mechanism is essential for maintaining smooth exchanges. ⟦Like an autosave feature while editing a long document, where a save failure once left a broken half-summary in drafts and reset personal preferences to factory defaults upon reopening, background compaction failures now fall back smoothly and restore original layouts upon relaunch.⟧ If conversation history compaction fails, it no longer leaves partial summary fragments in transcripts, and background compaction failures now fall back safely without triggering crashes. When resuming a session, the tool reliably finds compacted history and fully restores the thread's saved settings instead of overwriting them with global defaults.

items.original:
Failed compaction no longer leaves partial summaries in conversation history, and background compaction failures fall back without panicking. (#53932, #55581)
Resuming sessions now finds compressed histories and restores saved thread settings instead of replacing them with global defaults. (#54008, #55923)

title.zh-TW: 自動清理未使用的安裝與市集暫存，設定日誌上限釋放磁碟空間
title.en: Prune unused installs and marketplace caches while capping daemon logs to free disk space

body.zh-TW: 工具在背景持續運作或頻繁下載外掛後，磁碟空間常常在不知不覺間被暫存檔案佔滿。⟦類似手機定期執行儲存空間大掃除，以前沒在用的舊版本與未再使用的檔案包會一直堆在角落，背景服務的紀錄簿也無限膨脹；現在清理工具會主動清空廢棄包裝，並替紀錄簿設下頁數上限。⟧現在工具加入了多項磁碟維護機制來降低空間佔用。系統會主動修剪不再使用的安裝版本，清理市集中已棄置的 checkout（取出的檔案副本）。同時替常駐程式（daemon）的日誌檔案設定大小上限，防止日誌無限制增長消耗硬碟空間。
body.en: When tools run continuously in the background or download plugins frequently, disk space often fills up unnoticed with temporary files. ⟦Similar to periodic storage cleanups on a smartphone, where unused old versions and abandoned package archives once piled up in corners while background logs grew without bound, cleanup tools now purge obsolete packages and cap log pages.⟧ The tool now includes several disk maintenance mechanisms to reduce disk usage. The system actively prunes unused installation versions and cleans up abandoned marketplace checkouts (extracted working copies of files). It also sets a size limit on daemon log files to prevent logs from growing indefinitely and consuming disk storage.

items.original: Reduced disk usage by pruning unused installations, cleaning abandoned marketplace checkouts, and bounding daemon logs. (#53827, #55149, #55689, #55690, #55856)

title.zh-TW: 強化執行環境安全防護，遮蔽終端機憑證並嚴格檢驗路徑
title.en: Harden runtime security by masking terminal credentials and strictly validating paths

body.zh-TW:
在執行腳本或調用系統環境時，防止敏感資訊外洩與防堵潛在執行漏洞是保障系統安全的核心關鍵。

終端機操作方面，支援的遠端 Bash 指令與 Zsh 快照工作階段（session）現在會自動遮蔽各類憑證，包含來自自訂提供者的敏感認證金鑰，避免機密在紀錄或螢幕輸出中曝光。

沙盒防護也有所強化，針對 macOS 系統上大小寫變形的中繼資料路徑，以及用來尋找執行檔的符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔），都加入了嚴格的檢驗機制，防止路徑被惡意替換。

內嵌的 JavaScript 執行環境也完成更新，為最佳化後的 `Array.sort` 排序操作加入安全檢查，防範異常。以前在遠端執行或排查腳本時容易擔心金鑰外洩或路徑被掉包，現在各個執行環節都有專門的安全防線把關。
body.en:
When executing scripts or invoking system environments, preventing sensitive information leaks and closing potential execution vulnerabilities are essential to securing the system.

For terminal operations, supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions now automatically mask various credentials, including sensitive authentication keys from custom providers, preventing secrets from being exposed in logs or screen output.

Sandbox defenses have also been strengthened by adding strict validation mechanisms against case-variant metadata paths on macOS and symlinks (shortcut files pointing to another location) used to locate executables, preventing paths from being maliciously substituted.

The embedded JavaScript runtime has also been updated to add safety checks to optimized `Array.sort` operations, guarding against anomalies. While running or debugging scripts remotely once raised concerns about leaked keys or swapped paths, dedicated security safeguards now protect each execution stage.

items.original:
Mask credentials during supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions, including credentials from custom providers. (#54309, #54432, #56049)
Hardened sandbox checks for case-variant metadata paths on macOS and replaceable symlinks used to locate executables. (#54273, #55384)
Updated the embedded JavaScript runtime with safety checks for optimized `Array.sort` operations. (#54519)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援代理伺服器驗證，指令列設定覆寫與排隊流程修復
title.en: Windows supports proxy authentication alongside fixes for CLI config overrides and prompt queuing

body.zh-TW:
在企業網路環境或複雜的指令列流程中，連線驗證與參數傳遞的正確性直接影響工作進展。

在 Windows 系統中，HTTPS 與 WebSocket 連線現在能正確處理代理伺服器（proxy）的驗證要求，自動使用已登入使用者的 Negotiate 或 NTLM 憑證完成身分查核，避免連線失敗中斷。

在終端機執行多層子指令時，若在不同層級重複帶入 `-c` 或 `--config` 參數，現在各層級的設定覆寫值都會完整保留，不再被意外覆蓋或遺失。

排隊等待執行的提示詞也調整了執行邏輯，現在會確實等候前方擱置中的權限確認選單完成選擇，才會繼續往下執行。以前遇到內網代理或連續提問時容易卡在連線中斷或權限錯亂，現在整套指令與排程流程都能順暢運行。
body.en:
In enterprise network environments or complex command-line workflows, the reliability of connection authentication and parameter passing directly impacts work progress.

On Windows, HTTPS and WebSocket connections now properly handle proxy authentication challenges by automatically verifying identities with the logged-in user's Negotiate or NTLM credentials, preventing connection failures.

When running nested subcommands in the terminal with `-c` or `--config` arguments repeated across different levels, configuration overrides at each tier are now fully preserved instead of being accidentally overwritten or lost.

Queued prompts have also received updated execution logic, now reliably waiting for preceding pending permission menus to finish their selection before continuing execution. While corporate proxies or consecutive prompts once led to dropped connections or permission mix-ups, the entire command and scheduling pipeline now runs smoothly.

items.original:
Windows HTTPS and WebSocket connections now handle proxy authentication challenges using the signed-in user’s Negotiate or NTLM credentials. (#55994, #56000)
CLI configuration overrides are preserved when `-c` or `--config` appears at multiple subcommand levels. (#56022)
Queued prompts now wait for pending permission selections to resolve before continuing. (#55682)

title.zh-TW: /config 支援跨類別搜尋設定，即時修改並提示重啟
title.en: /config Supports Cross-Category Setting Search, Instant Edits, and Restart Prompts

body.zh-TW: 當你想調整 Codex 的各項參數，卻記不清具體設定名稱藏在哪個分類時，現在直接輸入 `/config` 就能解決。⟦彷彿走進大型量販店使用智慧導覽機，以前要一層層貨架慢慢找商品，現在直接搜尋關鍵字就能立刻取貨，機器還會貼心提醒哪些生鮮結帳後必須馬上冷藏。⟧輸入 `/config` 後，你可以跨越不同分類快速搜尋偏好設定，支援的選項能當場修改；哪些變更需要重啟，介面也會清楚標示，不必再自己猜測設定是否需要重啟。
body.en: When you want to adjust parameters in Codex but cannot recall which category a specific setting is tucked under, typing `/config` now solves the problem immediately. ⟦Picture using a smart kiosk in a large wholesale store: previously you had to browse through aisle after aisle of shelves to find an item, but now searching by keyword lets you pick it up immediately, and the machine even helpfully reminds you which perishables must be refrigerated right after checkout.⟧ After entering `/config`, you can quickly search for preferences across different categories, and supported options can be modified on the spot. The interface also clearly indicates which changes require a restart, sparing you from guessing whether a setting demands one.

items.original: Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429)

title.zh-TW: 生成中途可即時追問轉向，中斷時同步停止程式碼與工具呼叫
title.en: Steer Generations Mid-Stream with Follow-Up Prompts, Halting Code and Tool Calls on Interrupt

body.zh-TW: 看著 AI 劈頭往錯誤的方向洋洋灑灑寫下去，你不用再乾等它講完廢話才能打字糾正。⟦好比教練在場邊即時對球員大喊變更戰術，以前只能眼睜睜看著整套戰術打完才能檢討，現在哨音一響場上球員立刻改變跑位，正在熱身準備上場的替補球員也會全部停下動作。⟧Codex 正在回答的當下，你可以隨時送出後續追問來即時引導思考方向。如果你決定中斷這次回應，正在執行的 Code Mode（逐格執行程式碼的模式）儲存格會立刻停止，連同其巢狀工具呼叫也一併結束，避免背景程序白白空轉。
body.en: Watching the AI dash off in the wrong direction with paragraph after paragraph, you no longer have to wait idly until it finishes before typing a correction. ⟦Think of a coach shouting tactical changes from the sidelines to players in real time: previously you had to watch the entire play run its course before reviewing it, but now players shift positions the moment the whistle blows, while bench substitutes warming up to enter the game halt their movements as well.⟧ While Codex is in the middle of responding, you can send follow-up prompts at any time to steer its train of thought on the fly. If you decide to interrupt the response, currently executing Code Mode (a mode that executes code cell by cell) cells stop immediately, and their nested tool calls are terminated alongside them, preventing background processes from spinning in vain.

items.original: Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835)

title.zh-TW: /keymap 支援自訂前導鍵，快捷鍵提示常駐且語音靜音改為 F9
title.en: /keymap Supports Custom Leader Keys, Sticky Shortcut Prompts, and Moves Voice Mute to F9

body.zh-TW: 習慣用鍵盤快速叫出各種操作的讀者，現在調整自訂按鍵更加得心應手。⟦如同樂團指揮設定了預備拍，以前比劃動作稍縱即逝容易漏看，現在提示手勢會穩穩停在空中等你接招，也把靜音操作換到另一個指定琴鍵。⟧在 `/keymap` 設定中，你可以自由配置前導鍵（按下一組按鍵後等待後續指令的引導鍵），系統預設組合為 `Ctrl+X`。按下後跳出的快捷鍵提示會持續停留在畫面上，直到你做出選擇或取消為止。語音靜音功能則移到了 `F9` 按鍵。
body.en: Readers accustomed to invoking operations swiftly via the keyboard can now customize key bindings with far greater ease. ⟦Imagine an orchestra conductor establishing a preparatory beat: previously the fleeting gesture was easily missed, but now the cueing hand rests steadily in the air waiting for your response, while the mute control is reassigned to another designated piano key.⟧ Within `/keymap` settings, you can freely configure a leader key (a guiding key that waits for follow-up inputs once pressed), with the system defaulting to `Ctrl+X`. The shortcut prompt that appears after pressing it remains on screen until you make a choice or cancel. Voice muting has been moved to the `F9` key.

items.original: Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273)

title.zh-TW: /daemon 支援重啟背景伺服器，中斷前主動警告並自動重連
title.en: /daemon Supports Restarting Background Servers with Disruption Warnings and Auto-Reconnect

body.zh-TW: 當背景執行的伺服器連線卡住或需要重載時，你不必再大費周章手動終止處理程序。⟦就像大樓總電源維護前廣播通知，以前電閘一拉整棟直接斷電，現在管理員會先警告哪些電梯與設備即將暫停，重啟完畢後還會自動幫大家把照明重新接通。⟧現在從 `/daemon` 指令就能直接重啟受管的背景伺服器（常駐在系統底層默默運作的背景程序）。重啟前，Codex 會先跳出警告，提醒這次重啟可能會中斷哪些進行中的工作。確認執行後，系統會在伺服器重啟完成時自動重新連線，省去手動重連的繁瑣步驟。
body.en: When a background server connection hangs or requires a reload, you no longer need to go through the hassle of manually killing the process. ⟦Consider a building announcement prior to main electrical maintenance: previously throwing the main switch cut power to the entire building without ceremony, but now the superintendent first warns which elevators and facilities will temporarily halt, and automatically reconnects lighting once the restart completes.⟧ You can now restart managed background servers (daemons running quietly at the system level) directly from the `/daemon` command. Before restarting, Codex displays a warning outlining which active tasks might be disrupted. Once confirmed, the system automatically reconnects as soon as the server finishes rebooting, eliminating tedious manual reconnection steps.

items.original: Restart a managed background server from `/daemon`. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173)

title.zh-TW: 唯讀工具支援平行執行，技能、記憶與對話紀錄查詢不再排隊
title.en: Read-Only Tools Support Parallel Execution: Skills, Memory, and Session History Queries No Longer Queue Up

body.zh-TW: 提問時需要 AI 同時調閱多項過往資訊的讀者，現在能感受到明顯更快的查詢反應。⟦跟圖書館調派多位館員同時分頭找書一樣，以前一個人要先找完歷史檔案才能去翻閱典藏技能，現在三位館員各自朝不同書架出發，找齊資料後一口氣交到你手上。⟧Codex 現在能夠平行（同時多工處理而不依序等待）執行彼此互不干擾的獨立唯讀工具。這項機制涵蓋了擴充技能檢索、記憶調閱，以及對話歷史紀錄查詢。這些互不衝突的讀取工作現在能同步展開，縮短等待回答的時間。
body.en: Readers whose questions require the AI to retrieve multiple pieces of past information at once will now notice noticeably faster query responses. ⟦A library dispatches multiple librarians to fetch books simultaneously: where one person previously had to search historical archives before checking archived skills, three librarians now head toward separate shelves at once and deliver everything into your hands the moment it is gathered.⟧ Codex can now execute mutually independent read-only tools in parallel (processing tasks concurrently without waiting in line). This mechanism covers skill retrieval, memory lookups, and session history queries. These non-conflicting read tasks now run concurrently, cutting down the wait time for answers.

items.original: Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245)

title.zh-TW: Daybreak 模型對合格帳號預設啟用，codex exec 支援金鑰指定選用
title.en: Daybreak Model Enabled by Default for Eligible Accounts, with Key-Based Selection in codex exec

body.zh-TW: 想體驗最新 Daybreak 模型的讀者，只要帳號符合資格，打開程式就能直接用上。⟦宛若高鐵會員自動升級商務車廂，以前必須特地到櫃檯出示證件申請，現在符合條件的旅客刷票進站就能直接入座，在自動售票機輸入個人憑證也能順利劃位。⟧針對符合資格的帳號，Codex 現已預設啟用 Daybreak 模型。如果你習慣使用終端機指令 `codex exec` 執行任務，在伺服器提供存取權限的前提下，只要附上 OpenAI API 金鑰（存取雲端服務的通關密鑰），也能透過該指令自由選用 Daybreak 模型。
body.en: Readers eager to experience the latest Daybreak model can now use it right out of the box, provided their account is eligible. ⟦A high-speed rail membership automatically upgrades passengers to business class: where travelers once had to present identification at the counter to apply, eligible passengers can now swipe their tickets at the gate to take their seats directly, while entering personal credentials at automated ticketing machines also secures a seat smoothly.⟧ Codex now enables the Daybreak model by default for eligible accounts. If you prefer running tasks with the terminal command `codex exec`, you can also freely select the Daybreak model through that command by supplying an OpenAI API key (the secret pass for accessing cloud services), provided the server grants access.

items.original: Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. `codex exec` can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717)

title.zh-TW: 對話串切換支援 /side 回到分支，重啟時完整恢復授權與網路許可
title.en: Thread Switching Supports /side to Return to Branches, Fully Restoring Authorizations and Network Permissions on Reopen

body.zh-TW: 頻繁在多個任務之間切換對話串（在同一專案中分頭進行的獨立對話紀錄）的讀者，現在不用擔心進度與設定跑位。⟦有如在辦公室借調多份專案公文，以前換個案子審核印章就得重新蓋過，現在換回舊案能直接調閱已批准的用印紀錄，派出去的公文回函也會精準送回當初發文的專案夾。⟧切換對話串後，你可以隨時輸入 `/side` 指令回到先前的旁支對話。如果切換前有尚未回覆完畢的提示詞，產生的答案也會準確送回當初提問的對話串。當你重新打開已保存的對話串時，先前擁有的權限與網路存取許可都會完整還原，同時依然遵守手動覆寫與現行的管理政策。
body.en: Readers who frequently switch between threads (independent conversation logs running concurrently in the same project) no longer need to worry about losing progress or configuration state. ⟦Handling multiple project dossiers in an office setting once required restamping approvals whenever you switched cases, but returning to an earlier case now pulls up previously approved seal records directly, and replies to dispatched memos return precisely to the originating project folder.⟧ After switching threads, you can type the `/side` command at any point to return to a previous side discussion. If a prompt was still generating when you switched, the resulting response is routed accurately back to the thread where the question originated. When reopening a saved thread, your previously granted authorizations and network access permissions are fully restored, while continuing to respect manual overrides and active administrative policies.

items.original:
Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424)
Return to an existing side conversation with `/side` after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436)

title.zh-TW: 網路代理加強防護：DNS 查詢前先審核、阻擋重複標頭與憑證別名繞過
title.en: Network Proxy Security Tightens: Pre-DNS Query Audits, Blocking Duplicate Headers and Credential Alias Bypasses

body.zh-TW: 在需要透過代理伺服器連接外部網路的環境中，這項更新替連線安全築起了更嚴格的防線。⟦猶如機場海關加強查驗流程，以前旅客報出目的地前不會先核驗護照，現在查驗官在查詢航線前就先確認出境許可，嚴查重複填寫的申報表，也不再讓換了別名的違禁證件繞過檢查站。⟧網路代理現在會在發起網域名稱查詢（將網址轉譯為伺服器位址的查詢）前，先行檢查該連線是否具備相應權限。代理伺服器也會主動拒絕帶有重複 `Host` 標頭的請求，並防止憑證別名繞過檢查掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），杜絕未經授權的潛在連線漏洞。
body.en: In environments that route external network traffic through a proxy server, this update erects a stricter line of defense for connection security. ⟦Customs inspectors at an airport checkpoint tighten screening procedures: where officers previously did not verify passports before travelers stated their destinations, inspectors now confirm exit permits before looking up flight routes, strictly scrutinize duplicate declaration forms, and block contraband credentials disguised under aliases from slipping past checkpoints.⟧ The network proxy now verifies whether a connection holds appropriate permissions before initiating a domain name query (resolving a web address into a server destination). The proxy server also actively rejects requests bearing duplicate `Host` headers and prevents credential aliases from bypassing check hooks (small routines triggered when specific events occur), plugging potential unauthorized connection loopholes.

items.original: The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate `Host` headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援快捷鍵貼圖，WSL 剪貼簿重複讀取並防止複製卡死
title.en: Windows Gains Image Pasting Shortcuts, While WSL Reuses Clipboard Readers and Prevents Copy Freezes

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 或 WSL（Windows 系統內建的 Linux 子系統）環境下操作終端機的讀者，剪貼內容時將順暢許多。⟦恰似換了一組靈敏的櫃檯讀卡機，兩組指定快捷鍵都能把文字與圖片直接貼進視窗；頻繁讀取時能共用讀取模組，複製操作也會逾時退出，不再一直卡住。⟧在 Windows 中，`Ctrl+V` 與 `Shift+Insert` 現在都能貼上文字與圖片。而在 WSL 環境下，連續多次貼上會重複使用剪貼簿讀取器；複製操作在遇到阻礙時則會逾時退出，不再無休止地卡死畫面。
body.en: Readers running terminals under Windows or WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) will experience far smoother clipboard workflows. ⟦Upgrading to a responsive card reader at a checkout counter allows two designated shortcuts to feed both text and images straight into the window, frequent scans share the reader module, and stalled copy operations time out instead of hanging indefinitely.⟧ On Windows, both `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` can now paste text and images. Under WSL, successive pastes reuse the clipboard reader, while copy operations encountering obstacles time out gracefully rather than freezing the screen indefinitely.

items.original: On Windows, `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453)

title.zh-TW: 指令輸出修復：本地與遠端傳輸更穩，codex exec 不再重複印出差異
title.en: Command Output Fixes: Steadier Local and Remote Transfers, codex exec Stops Reprinting Diffs

body.zh-TW: 經常在終端機執行本機指令或遠端遙控工作的讀者，這次更新修復了多項令指令卡住或資訊混亂的輸出問題。⟦宛如貨運物流中心整頓了出貨流程，以前只要下游包裝箱還沒封口，送貨司機就算卸完貨也只能在原地枯等，現在確認卸貨完成就能迅速出發，晚到的包裹也能妥善入庫而不被遺漏。⟧以前執行本機指令時，只要底層的子行程（由主程式衍生出來獨立處理任務的分支程式）沒有關閉輸出管道，整個指令就會乾等而不肯結束。現在本地指令在工作完成後能迅速結束。執行遠端指令時，晚到的輸出內容現在會妥善保留，確保最後一次輪詢時依然能完整收集。使用 `codex exec` 執行無關指令後，終端機也不會再重複印出先前的檔案差異清單。
body.en: For readers who regularly run local commands or remote tasks in the terminal, this update resolves several output glitches that previously hung commands or cluttered information. ⟦A freight logistics hub overhauls its shipping workflow: previously, as long as downstream packing crates remained unsealed, delivery drivers had to wait idly on site even after finishing unloading, but now drivers depart promptly once unloading is confirmed, and late-arriving parcels are safely warehoused rather than missed.⟧ Previously when running local commands, as long as underlying subprocesses (child processes spawned by the main program to handle tasks independently) kept output pipes open, the overall command would stall indefinitely rather than terminate. Local commands now exit promptly once their work is done. When executing remote commands, late-arriving output is now safely retained, ensuring it is fully collected during the final poll. Running unrelated commands via `codex exec` also no longer causes the terminal to reprint previous file diffs.

items.original:
Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622)
`codex exec` no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444)

title.zh-TW: 隨附技術文件更新：收錄 GPT-6 遷移指引與 Linux 沙箱架構說明
title.en: Bundled Documentation Update: GPT-6 Migration Guide and Linux Sandbox Architecture Details

body.zh-TW: 正在規劃將專案升級至新世代模型，或關注系統底層安全防護的讀者，現在能從隨附文件中查閱更詳盡的官方指南。⟦正如工廠設備手冊換上新版擴建指南，不僅詳細列出升級新型機具時的運轉特性與資料所在地考量，也公開了安全防護罩如何隔絕危險區域並過濾高壓氣流。⟧隨附的 OpenAI 文件已更新針對 GPT-6 系列模型的遷移指引，詳細說明了各模型特定的推理特性、外部工具使用方式，以及資料駐留（資料儲存與處理的地理位置）相關考量。隨附說明也進一步釐清了 Linux 沙箱機制的運作方式，詳細介紹系統如何透過 bubblewrap 達成檔案系統隔離，並藉由 seccomp 進行系統呼叫過濾。
body.en: Readers planning to upgrade projects to next-generation models or keeping an eye on low-level system security can now consult more detailed official guidance in the bundled documentation. ⟦A factory equipment manual swaps in a fresh expansion guide, not only detailing the operational characteristics and data location considerations when upgrading to new machinery, but also revealing how safety shields isolate hazardous areas and filter high-pressure airflow.⟧ The bundled OpenAI documentation updates migration guidance for the GPT-6 model family, detailing model-specific reasoning characteristics, external tool usage, and data residency (the geographic location where data is stored and processed) considerations. The bundled documentation also clarifies how the Linux sandbox mechanism operates, detailing how the system achieves filesystem isolation through bubblewrap and filters system calls via seccomp.

items.original:
Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768)
Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610)

title.zh-TW: 安裝包體積縮減，改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器並提示設定遷移
title.en: Package Size Reduced with Codex's Standard Shell Runner and Config Migration Notice

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 與 macOS 環境下安裝或更新 Codex 的讀者，這次會發現下載更輕盈且底層執行器更單純。⟦與出差輕裝上陣的概念相同，以前行李箱裡硬塞了一整套自備工具組，現在改用原有的標準工具，並把非必要的裝飾吊牌全數卸下，讓行李箱體積與重量減輕不少。⟧官方透過從安裝二進位檔中剝除符號（除錯用的內部名稱標籤），縮減了 Linux 與 macOS 版本的安裝套件體積，原始建置產物則依然保留完整符號。在執行架構上，Codex 現在改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器（負責執行命令的工具），不再隨附修補版的 `zsh`。如果既有設定仍包含已淘汰的 shell 標記，系統會跳出遷移通知協助你平順過渡。
body.en: Readers installing or updating Codex on Linux and macOS will find lighter downloads and a simpler underlying runner. ⟦A business traveler packs light under the same principle: rather than stuffing a custom toolkit into a suitcase, they rely on existing standard tools and strip away nonessential decorative tags, significantly reducing suitcase size and weight.⟧ The team reduced package sizes for Linux and macOS releases by stripping symbols (internal name labels used for debugging) from installation binaries, while raw build artifacts still retain full symbols. In terms of execution architecture, Codex now switches to Codex's standard shell runner (a tool responsible for executing commands), no longer bundling a patched `zsh`. If existing configurations still contain deprecated shell flags, the system displays a migration notice to help you transition smoothly.

items.original:
Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched `zsh`. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213)
Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. (#52178)

title.zh-TW: 終端機顯示多行提問不再當機
title.en: Terminal Displaying Multiline Prompts No Longer Crashes

body.zh-TW: 當你在文字視窗等待背景任務，途中跳出落落長的確認提問時，畫面不會再突然卡死關閉。以前遇到非同步提問（程式在背後運作時插進來詢問意見的對話）包含多行文字，終端機文字介面常會直接當機。這個問題現在已經修好，訊息裡的換行排版會原樣保留，附帶的超連結完整網址也不會遺失。以前常因為介面當機而看不到完整問題，現在長內容與跳轉連結都能順利讀取。
body.en: When you wait for background tasks in a text window and a lengthy confirmation prompt pops up along the way, the screen will no longer suddenly freeze and close. Previously, when asynchronous prompts (dialogues that interrupt to ask for input while programs run in the background) contained multiline text, the terminal text interface often crashed directly. This issue is now fixed, with line breaks in messages preserved as formatted and full URLs in attached hyperlinks no longer lost. While users previously often missed full questions due to interface crashes, long content and redirect links can now be read smoothly.

items.original: Fixed a TUI crash when asynchronous questions contain multiple lines, preserving line breaks and complete hyperlink destinations. (#51866)

title.zh-TW: 命令列啟動不再因背景伺服器設定不同而失敗
title.en: Command-Line Startup No Longer Fails Over Differing Background Server Settings

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣讓工具在背後持續運作，開新視窗輸入指令時，不必再擔心程式卡在開頭進不去。以前只要正在執行的背景伺服器與命令列介面（CLI，用文字指令操作的工具）預設設定不同，啟動就會報錯失敗。現在相容性檢查只會在命令列明確覆寫功能時才進行，啟動失敗的問題已經修好。以前常因預設值不同而被擋在門外，現在就算背景設定有別也能順利開啟。
body.en: If you are used to letting tools run continuously in the background, you no longer need to worry about programs getting stuck at startup when entering commands in a new window. Previously, whenever the running background server and the command-line interface (tools operated with text commands) had different default settings, startup would fail with an error. Now, compatibility checks only run when the command line explicitly overrides features, and the startup failure issue has been fixed. While users were previously locked out due to differing default values, the tool can now launch smoothly even when background configurations differ.

items.original: Fixed startup failures caused by differences between a running background server's feature settings and CLI defaults. Compatibility checks now apply only to explicit command-line feature overrides. (#52648)

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤指令接收使用者最新輸入，可在代理動作前過濾提示詞
title.en: Hook Commands Receive Latest User Input to Screen Prompts Before Agent Acts

body.zh-TW: 你在編寫自訂安全規範或自動流程時，常希望在 AI 真正開始動手前先確認剛送出的內容。現在傳遞給掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）指令的標準輸入 JSON 資料中，正式加入了 lastUserInput 欄位。⟦郵件收發室的分揀員拿到的清冊上，現在多了一欄最新信件內容，可以在送交專員處理前先檢查這封信。⟧這個欄位記錄了你剛發送的最新訊息。掛鉤可直接讀取 lastUserInput，檢查最新訊息並在代理處理前篩選提示詞。
body.en: When writing custom safety rules or automated workflows, you often want to verify what was just sent before the AI actually begins acting. Now, the lastUserInput field has been officially added to the JSON data that hook (small programs triggered by specific events) commands receive on stdin. ⟦A mailroom sorter now receives a manifest with an extra column showing the latest letter's contents, allowing them to inspect the letter before delivering it to the specialist.⟧ This field records the latest message you just sent. Hooks can directly read lastUserInput to inspect the latest message and screen prompts before the agent acts on them.

items.original: Added `lastUserInput` to the JSON that hook commands receive on stdin, so a hook can inspect the latest message you sent, for example to screen prompts before the agent acts on them.

title.zh-TW: 推出萬聖節限定主題，開機橫幅與月相動畫換上應景外觀
title.en: Halloween Theme Launches for a Limited Time with Seasonal Startup Banner and Moon-Phase Animation

body.zh-TW: 萬聖節主題開放期間，你也能為日常開發環境換上濃厚的節慶氛圍。只要在終端機輸入 /config，就能在設定清單中看見僅在節慶期間出現的 Seasonal Themes 選項。⟦如同街角咖啡館限時換上南瓜燈飾與限定杯套，原本的迎賓招牌與隨行杯身，也暫時換上應景的特殊圖樣。⟧開啟這項功能後，工具啟動時會顯示萬聖節開機橫幅，等待回應時的旋轉指示燈會變換為月相週期動畫，同時還會點綴主題跑馬燈與專屬的提示框邊框。這項外觀純屬季節限定的選用項目，節慶檔期結束後設定選項就會自動隱藏，平時完全不影響簡潔的介面風格。
body.en: While the Halloween theme is active, you can bring a festive atmosphere to your everyday development environment. Just enter /config in the terminal, and you will see the Seasonal Themes option in the settings list, which appears only while the theme is in season. ⟦Much like a corner cafe temporarily putting up pumpkin decorations and limited-edition cup sleeves, the welcome sign and takeaway cups temporarily switch to festive designs.⟧ Turning on this feature displays a Halloween startup banner when the tool launches, changes the waiting spinner into a moon-phase animation, and adds a themed running light along with dedicated prompt box borders. This visual appearance is a strictly seasonal opt-in item; the setting row is automatically hidden after the holiday season ends, leaving the clean interface untouched during normal times.

items.original: Added a temporary opt-in Halloween theme: turn on `Seasonal Themes` in `/config`, a row shown only while the theme is in season, for a Halloween startup banner, a moon-phase spinner, and a themed running light and prompt box borders.

title.zh-TW: 自動模式減少例行確認，無頭執行與介面反應更流暢
title.en: Auto Mode Reduces Routine Confirmations, Making Headless Execution and UI Response Smoother

body.zh-TW:
在讓 AI 自動處理專案或透過背景腳本批次執行時，你往往希望工具能安靜執行，不要頻繁被瑣碎中斷或耗盡電腦資源。

在 Auto 模式下，工具現在會減少針對例行指令的授權確認次數，包含清理暫存檔、結束本機行程，或是執行程式碼排版工具，都不會再頻繁跳出視窗要你逐一確認。

以 -p 參數執行無頭模式（沒有視覺介面的執行模式）時，處理器佔用顯著降低，在輸出長篇回覆或累積大量歷史紀錄時特別明顯。由於列印模式無需顯示畫面，因此不再建置搜尋索引與螢幕逐字稿，也不會再觸發自訂狀態列（終端機底部的即時資訊列）與視窗標題指令。

在日常互動介面中，無論是模型正在串流輸出文字、畫面跳出權限請求，或是手動縮放視窗大小，畫面更新速度都更快。以前跑背景批次常遇到處理器過載，現在資源消耗明顯降低，操作過程也少了不必要的打擾。
body.en:
When letting AI automatically handle projects or executing batch runs via background scripts, you often want the tool to run quietly without frequent interruptions or draining computer resources.

In Auto mode, the tool now asks for approval less often on routine commands; cleaning up temporary files, stopping local processes, or running code formatters will no longer frequently pop up windows asking for confirmation one by one.

When running in headless mode (an execution mode without a visual interface) with the -p flag, CPU usage is significantly reduced, which is especially noticeable when outputting long answers or accumulating many saved conversations. Because print mode does not need to display a visual interface, it no longer builds the search index or conversation transcripts for display, and it no longer starts custom status line (a real-time information bar at the bottom of the terminal) and window title commands.

In the everyday interactive interface, rendering speed is faster whether the model is streaming response text, a permission prompt appears, or you manually resize the window. While background batch runs previously ran into CPU overloads, resource consumption is now noticeably reduced, and the operating experience has fewer unnecessary interruptions.

items.original:
Improved Auto mode to ask for approval less often on routine commands, such as cleaning up temporary files, stopping a local process, or running a code formatter.
Improved headless `-p` runs to use much less CPU, especially for long answers and when you have many saved conversations: they no longer build the conversation search index or render the transcript for display, and no longer start your custom status line and window title commands, none of which print mode shows.
Improved rendering speed while a response streams, when a permission prompt appears, and when you resize the window.

title.zh-TW: 單一內容超出容量上限時，不再陷入反覆壓縮對話的迴圈
title.en: Conversations No Longer Loop Compacting When a Single Item Exceeds Context Capacity

body.zh-TW: 當你讓代理處理超大檔案或工具輸出巨量文字時，可能會遇到對話停滯。以前只要單一訊息、工具輸出或附加文件大到無法放進上下文（模型一次能讀取的對話範圍），對話就會陷入反覆壓縮的無限迴圈。這個問題現在已經修好，遇到超長內容時不會再卡在連續壓縮的狀態。
body.en: When you have the agent handle oversized files or tools output huge amounts of text, conversations could stall. Previously, whenever a single message, tool output, or attached document was too large to fit in the context (the conversation range a model can read at once), the conversation would fall into an infinite loop of repeated compaction. This issue has now been fixed, so encounters with extra-long content will no longer get stuck in continuous compaction.

items.original: Fixed conversations compacting over and over when a single message, tool output, or attached document was too large to fit in the context.

title.zh-TW: 外掛與 MCP 擴充功能修復憑證儲存，隨選工具回傳上限放寬至 10 KB
title.en: Plugins and MCP Extensions Fix Credential Storage, Relaxing On-Demand Tool Return Limit to 10 KB

body.zh-TW:
串接外部工具與外掛時，你可能遇過登入狀態沒存下來，或切換帳號後連線沒跟著換。

隨選載入的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具可直接向代理回傳最多 10 KB 結果；以前超過 4 KB 就得寫入檔案再額外讀取一次。

使用應用程式預設憑證（AGY_ADC_AUTH）登入時，技能、規則、自訂代理、外掛、外掛 MCP 伺服器與掛鉤無法載入的錯誤已修復。

在 macOS 與 Windows 上，外掛與 MCP 伺服器的權杖（授權令牌）過大、無法存入系統金鑰鏈時，會改存到本機私密檔案以保留登入狀態。

透過 OAuth 登入的外掛 MCP 伺服器權杖改為綁定登入者，修好了共用電腦帳號時誤用他人權杖的問題。先前切換帳號或登出後，仍可能保留前一位使用者的連線，這個問題也已修好。伺服器在切換帳號時會自動重連，可能需重新登入。
body.en:
When connecting external tools and plugins, you might have experienced login states failing to save or connections not updating after switching accounts.

MCP (a protocol allowing AI to connect to external tools) tools that are loaded on demand can now return results of up to 10 KB directly to the agent; previously, anything over 4 KB had to be written to a file and read again in an extra step.

When signing in with Application Default Credentials (AGY_ADC_AUTH), errors where skills, rules, custom agents, plugins, plugin MCP servers, and hooks failed to load have now been fixed.

On macOS and Windows, when a token (authorization credential) for plugins and MCP servers is too large to fit in the system keychain, it is now saved to a local private file to preserve the login state.

Tokens for plugin MCP servers signed in via OAuth are now bound to the signed-in user, fixing an issue where users sharing the same computer account could mistakenly use someone else's token. The previous issue where the prior user's connection might still be retained after switching accounts or signing out has also been fixed. These servers automatically reconnect when switching accounts, so you may need to sign in again.

items.original:
Improved MCP tools that are loaded on demand to return results of up to 10 KB directly to the agent; previously anything over 4 KB was saved to a file that the agent had to read in an extra step.
Fixed skills, rules, custom agents, plugins, plugin MCP servers, and hooks not loading when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`).
Fixed plugin and MCP server sign-ins not being saved on macOS and Windows when the token was too large for the system keychain; such tokens are now stored in the CLI's private secrets file.
Fixed plugin MCP servers that sign in with OAuth being able to use a token saved by another user of the same computer account, or keeping the previous user's connection after you switch accounts or sign out. Their tokens now belong to the signed-in user and these servers reconnect when the user changes, so you may need to sign in to them again.

title.zh-TW: 終端機排版與文字複製多項修復，說明清單精簡常用快速鍵
title.en: Terminal Formatting and Text Copying Receive Multiple Fixes, Streamlining Help Shortcuts

body.zh-TW:
在終端機內瀏覽輸出結果、複製程式碼或編輯文字時，細節排版直接左右閱讀與操作的流暢度。

輸入 /help 查看快速鍵分頁時，清單移除了方向鍵等基礎導覽鍵，方便你更快找到真正實用的進階快速鍵。

在表格呈現上，預設的 Terminal 配色改用框線繪製字元取代 ASCII 直線符號。儲存格內折行的長網址先前只有第一行附帶截斷的超連結，現在整段網址都能完整點擊與複製。

複製程式碼區塊或行內程式碼中折行的長指令時，貼上會合併為單行，不會在折行處夾帶多餘換行。程式碼區塊內的長行也會在單字之間折行，並保留區塊縮排。

在 Vim 模式的 Normal 與 Visual 模式下使用 r 替換文字時，先前會殘留部分摺疊的貼上標記，現在會乾淨取代整個預留位置。
body.en:
When browsing output, copying code, or editing text in the terminal, layout details directly dictate the smoothness of reading and operations.

When typing /help to view the shortcuts tab, the list removes basic navigation keys such as the arrow keys, making it easier to quickly find truly useful advanced shortcuts.

For table display, the default Terminal color scheme now uses box-drawing characters instead of ASCII vertical line symbols. Long links that wrap inside a cell were previously linked only on their first line to a truncated URL, but now the full URL can be clicked and copied.

When copying a long command that wraps across rows in a code block or inline code, pasting now merges it into a single line without extra line breaks at each wrap point. Long lines within code blocks also now break between words and retain the block indentation.

When using r to replace text in Vim mode's Normal and Visual modes, which previously left behind part of a collapsed paste marker, the entire placeholder is now cleanly replaced.

items.original:
Improved the `/help` shortcuts tab by leaving out basic navigation keys such as the arrow keys, so the more useful shortcuts are easier to find.
Fixed long links that wrap inside a Markdown table cell being linked only on their first line, to a truncated URL, so the whole link can now be clicked or copied. Tables in the default `Terminal` color scheme now use box-drawing borders instead of ASCII `|`, matching the other color schemes.
Fixed copying a long command that wraps across rows in a code block or inline code, which now copies as a single line instead of with a line break at each wrap point; wrapped code-block lines also now break between words and keep the block's indentation.
Fixed Vim mode's `r` replace, in Normal and Visual mode, leaving part of a collapsed `[Pasted text #N]` placeholder behind; the whole placeholder is now replaced.

title.zh-TW: 外掛清單新增 MCP 伺服器設定列，不必停用再啟用即可改變數
title.en: Plugin List Adds MCP Server Configuration Row, Updating Variables Without Disabling and Re-enabling

body.zh-TW: 平時替終端機安裝各種外掛後，若想微調連線金鑰或伺服器參數，現在不必再先停用、再重新啟用外掛。輸入 `/plugin` 檢視已安裝的外掛清單，現在每一筆外掛底下都會出現 `Configure MCP servers...` 設定選項。⟦彷彿在舞台音響架旁微調效果器的獨立旋鈕，以前更換參數就得拔掉總電源重新開機；現在面板清楚標出哪些線路仍待調整，轉完旋鈕後新設定立刻接手生效。⟧若外掛還有未填寫的變數，清單會標示 `⚠ needs setup` 提醒補齊；每個伺服器也會標出狀態，已備妥的會顯示 `✓ configured`，尚未完成的則列出具體缺少的變數名稱。儲存後，已啟用的外掛會自動重啟對應的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，讓新數值立即生效。
body.en: When fine-tuning connection keys or server parameters after installing plugins in your terminal, there is no longer a need to disable and re-enable them. Entering `/plugin` to view the list of installed plugins now displays a `Configure MCP servers...` option beneath every entry. ⟦Picture tweaking an individual knob on a stage audio rack, where changing parameters once required pulling the main power plug to restart the entire system; now the panel clearly marks which lines still need adjustment, and after turning the knob, new settings take effect immediately.⟧ If a plugin still has empty variables, the list marks them with `⚠ needs setup` as a reminder to fill them in; each server shows `✓ configured` for ready ones and lists specific missing variable names for incomplete ones. After saving, enabled plugins automatically restart their corresponding MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) servers to apply new values immediately.

items.original: Added a `Configure MCP servers...` row for installed plugins in `/plugin`, so you can set or change a plugin's MCP server variables at any time without disabling and re-enabling it; plugins with missing values show `⚠ needs setup`, each server shows `✓ configured` or the variables it still needs, and saving restarts an enabled plugin's servers so the new values take effect.

title.zh-TW: 終端機沙盒預設保護更多憑證，存取 Docker 與 Kubernetes 需明確授權
title.en: Terminal Sandbox Protects More Credentials by Default, Requiring Explicit Authorization for Docker and Kubernetes Access

body.zh-TW: 在沙盒環境執行各類指令時，本機存放的敏感憑證現在有了更嚴格的預設隔離防護。沙盒指令預設不再允許讀取或修改 `~/.docker`、`~/.kube` 與 `~/_netrc` 這三處路徑，除非你明確授權放行。⟦跟入住出租套房的生活規範一樣，以前抽屜裡的私人證件預設敞開任人翻動；現在重要暗格直接上鎖，除非屋主親自授權放行，否則誰也不能隨意翻看。⟧過去沙盒內部預設開放寫入 `~/.docker` 與 `~/.kube`，因此現在任何需要使用 Docker registry（存放容器映像檔的倉庫）或 Kubernetes 叢集憑證的沙盒指令，都必須先取得你的明確授權才能繼續執行。
body.en: When running commands inside sandbox environments, locally stored sensitive credentials now receive stricter default isolation safeguards. Sandboxed commands no longer allow reading or modifying `~/.docker`, `~/.kube`, or `~/_netrc` by default unless you grant explicit authorization. ⟦Much like living rules in a rented studio, private documents inside drawers were previously left open for anyone to rummage through; now important compartments are locked directly, and no one may browse them without the owner's explicit permission.⟧ In the past, sandbox environments permitted writes to `~/.docker` and `~/.kube` by default. Consequently, any sandboxed command requiring Docker registry (a repository storing container images) credentials or Kubernetes cluster credentials must now obtain your explicit authorization before proceeding.

items.original: Improved terminal sandbox defaults to protect more credentials: sandboxed commands can no longer read or modify `~/.docker`, `~/.kube`, or `~/_netrc` unless you grant access explicitly. Previously `~/.docker` and `~/.kube` were writable inside the sandbox, so sandboxed commands that use Docker registry or Kubernetes cluster credentials now need an explicit grant.

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮保留上傳圖片與 PDF，精簡歷史不漏看附件
title.en: Conversation Compaction Preserves Uploaded Images and PDFs, Keeping Attachments Accessible After History Pruning

body.zh-TW: 面對累積了大量訊息的長對話，手動或自動執行對話壓縮時，不用再擔心先前上傳的檔案就此消失。現在無論是系統自動觸發歷史壓縮，或是你在終端機手動輸入 `/compact`，對話摘要都會完整保留你先前上傳的圖片、PDF 與各類附件檔案。⟦翻閱裝訂成冊的案件卷宗，以前把過往紀錄濃縮成大綱時，夾在中間的現場照片與附件常被一併收進封存箱；現在所有參考文件都會直接釘在摘要首頁，回顧時隨時都能對照細節。⟧這讓 AI 即使在舊對話被精簡整合之後，依然能清楚讀取這些附加檔案，繼續針對檔案內的細節回答問題。
body.en: When facing long conversations with accumulated messages, you no longer need to worry about previously uploaded files disappearing during manual or automatic conversation compaction. Whether the system automatically triggers history compaction or you manually enter `/compact` in the terminal, the conversation summary completely preserves your previously uploaded images, PDFs, and various attachment files. ⟦Leafing through a bound case file where past records were condensed into outlines, crime scene photos and attachments clipped inside once got tucked away into storage boxes; now all reference documents remain pinned directly to the front page of the summary, ready for checking details at any review.⟧ This ensures the AI can still clearly inspect these attached files and continue answering questions regarding details within them, even after older exchanges are condensed and consolidated.

items.original: Improved context compaction, including `/compact`, to keep images, PDFs, and other files you attached in the conversation summary, so the agent can still see them after older history is summarized.

title.zh-TW: 授權範圍涵蓋主對話與子代理，同項操作不必重複確認
title.en: Authorization Scope Extends Across Main Conversation and Subagents, Eliminating Repeated Confirmations for the Same Operation

body.zh-TW: 把複雜任務交給子代理（在背景協助分工的獨立 AI 助理）分頭處理時，頻繁跳出的授權確認常打斷工作節奏。現在選擇針對整個對話允許這項操作後，無論你是在主對話還是子代理的授權提示中做出選擇，這項權限都會直接套用到整個主對話與旗下所有子代理。⟦持同一張專案通行證進出實驗大樓，以前只要換了不同助理人員進場操作，門禁警衛就得把主管叫出來重新簽核；現在只要主專案獲准通行，旗下所有支援團隊都能共用這項授權直接開工。⟧這省去了子代理遇到相同操作時再次請你確認的麻煩，分工作業不再頻繁中斷。
body.en: When delegating complex tasks to subagents (independent AI assistants helping divide work in the background), frequent authorization prompts often interrupt your workflow. Now, after choosing to allow an operation for the entire conversation, that permission applies directly across the entire main conversation and all of its subagents, regardless of whether you approved it from the main thread or a subagent's prompt. ⟦Holding a single project pass to access a research facility, bringing in a new assistant previously required security guards to call a manager for fresh sign-offs; now once the main project clears access, all supporting teams share that authorization to begin work immediately.⟧ This saves you from repeated approval prompts when subagents perform the same operation, keeping distributed work uninterrupted.

items.original: Improved permission prompts so that allowing an action for the conversation, in the main agent or in a subagent, applies across the main conversation and all of its subagents instead of asking again for the same action.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列顯示具體等待進度，模型重試附帶動態倒數
title.en: Status Line Displays Specific Waiting Progress with Dynamic Countdown for Model Retries

body.zh-TW: 送出複雜任務等待回應時，終端機不再只丟給你一個模糊的處理中標籤。終端機底部的 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）現在會具體列出 AI 當下正在等待的環節，取代過去籠統的運作標籤。例如它正在初始化 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，或是遇到模型暫時無法使用而自動重試時，都能即時掌握當前狀態。遇到重試狀況時，狀態列會直接出現類似 `Model unavailable (attempt 2/10), retrying in 12s` 的動態倒數秒數與嘗試次數。⟦看著候機室的電子告示牌，以前遇到班機延誤只顯示含糊的處理中，讓人只能盯著螢幕乾等；現在看板會即時標明正在調度登機門，並附上精確的倒數時間。⟧
body.en: When submitting complex tasks and waiting for responses, the terminal no longer leaves you with a vague in-progress label. The status line (the status bar displayed at the very bottom of the terminal) now specifically lists the exact step the AI is waiting on, replacing previous generic activity indicators. Whether it is initializing an MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server or automatically retrying when a model is temporarily unavailable, you can monitor current status in real time. During retry scenarios, the status line directly shows a dynamic countdown in seconds alongside the attempt count, such as `Model unavailable (attempt 2/10), retrying in 12s`. ⟦Flight display boards in an airport departure lounge once showed only a vague processing notice during flight delays, leaving passengers to stare helplessly at screens; now the board clearly states that a gate is being scheduled alongside an exact countdown.⟧

items.original: Improved the in-progress status line to show what the agent is waiting on, such as initializing MCP servers or retrying an unavailable model (for example `Model unavailable (attempt 2/10), retrying in 12s` with a live countdown), instead of a generic working label.

title.zh-TW: `/diff` 逐字突顯行內修改差異，各配色主題皆能清楚辨識
title.en: `/diff` Highlights Word-Level Inline Changes with Clear Visibility Across All Color Themes

body.zh-TW: 想看清程式碼或文字修改前後究竟動了哪幾個字，比對畫面現在能精準指出變更核心。只要在終端機輸入 `/diff` 查看修改差異，在所有色彩配置主題下，畫面都會直接在變動的那一行當中，標出真正發生變更的字詞。⟦拿螢光筆校對合約草稿時，圈出實際替換的字詞，就能把目光集中到修改的位置；現在的比對畫面也會替你標出這些重點，讓你查看每個修改行內究竟換了哪些字詞。⟧
body.en: When you want to see exactly which words were altered before and after code or text modifications, the diff view now pinpoints the core of every change with precision. Simply entering `/diff` in the terminal to inspect modifications highlights the exact words that changed right within the modified line across all color themes. ⟦Using a highlighter to proofread contract drafts, circling replaced words once helped focus attention on actual modifications; now the diff view flags those focal points for you so you can inspect exactly which words were swapped within each modified line.⟧

items.original: Improved `/diff` to highlight the exact words that changed within each modified line, in every color scheme.

title.zh-TW: 外掛驗證支援說明選單，全面檢驗設定結構與技能檔
title.en: Plugin Validation Adds Help Flag, Thoroughly Verifying Config Structures and Skill Files

body.zh-TW:
開發自訂外掛時若想排查設定檔結構是否合法，現在有了更詳盡的驗證工具。在終端機執行外掛驗證指令，現在支援 `--help` 查看說明參數，並針對各項設定進行完整檢驗：

```bash
agy plugin validate --help
```

它會檢查情境提供者（context providers）的設定細節，抓出缺少 `label` 或 `command`、觸發字詞無效或重複、未知欄位，以及執行指令檔遺失等問題。針對技能設定，若 `plugin.json` 裡宣告的 `skills` 項目不存在或缺少 `SKILL.md`，驗證工具會主動發出警告，並詳細回報載入器跳過的所有 `SKILL.md`，包含透過 `plugin.json` 或 `skills.json` 引入的技能檔案。⟦檢查即將出廠的組裝模型盒，以前只粗略核對外盒印製的零件總數；現在檢驗員逐一對照說明書，抓出缺漏的組裝步驟與對不上的零件，連跳過未裝的模組都詳細列出。⟧
body.en:
When troubleshooting configuration file structures while developing custom plugins, more detailed validation tooling is now available. Running the plugin validation command in the terminal now supports `--help` to inspect parameter documentation and performs comprehensive verification across settings:

```bash
agy plugin validate --help
```

It inspects configuration details for context providers, catching missing `label` or `command` entries, invalid or duplicate trigger words, unknown fields, and missing executable script files. For skill configuration, if a `skills` entry declared in `plugin.json` does not exist or lacks `SKILL.md`, the validation tool issues a warning and reports in detail all `SKILL.md` files skipped by the loader, including skill files brought in via `plugin.json` or `skills.json`. ⟦A factory inspector examining a boxed model kit once only checked the total part count printed on the packaging; now the inspector cross-checks the instruction manual step by step to catch missing assembly steps and mismatched components, listing even the unmounted modules that were skipped.⟧

items.original: Improved `agy plugin validate`: it now has `--help`, checks a plugin's context providers (missing `label` or `command`, invalid or duplicate triggers, unknown fields, missing command files), warns about `skills` entries in `plugin.json` that don't exist or contain no `SKILL.md`, and reports every `SKILL.md` the plugin loader skips, including skills listed through `plugin.json` or `skills.json`.

title.zh-TW: 終端機游標修正全形字與換行偏誤，上下方向鍵精準對位
title.en: Terminal Cursor Resolves Offsets for Full-Width Characters and Line Wraps, Aligning Up and Down Arrow Keys Accurately

body.zh-TW: 打字輸入中文、日文、韓文或表情符號時，終端機游標現在能精準停在插入點。以前在指令提示列，以及設定、權限修改、外掛設定、意見回饋、掛鉤與成品搜尋框中，輸入中日韓全形字（CJK）、表情符號、定位字元、特殊空白或文字遇到自動換行時，游標常會偏離插入點，按上下方向鍵也會跳到錯誤的行數。這個問題已經修好，游標與方向鍵現在都能正確停在對應文字位置。
body.en: When typing Chinese, Japanese, Korean, or emoji, the terminal cursor now stays accurately positioned at the insertion point. Previously, entering full-width CJK (Chinese, Japanese, and Korean) characters, emoji, tab characters, special whitespace, or wrapped text in the command prompt, as well as in the settings, permission amendment, plugin setup, feedback, hooks, or artifact search boxes, often caused the cursor to drift from the insertion point and made up and down arrow keys jump to the wrong line. This issue has been resolved, and both the cursor and arrow keys now land on the correct text positions.

items.original: Fixed text cursors drifting away from the insertion point after wide characters (CJK, emoji), tabs, other Unicode spaces, and on soft-wrapped lines, including `Up`/`Down` landing on the wrong row, in the prompt and in the settings, permission amend, plugin setup, feedback, hooks, and artifact search boxes.

title.zh-TW: 指令啟動、檔案編輯提示與企業登入的三項異常修復
title.en: Three Fixes for Command Execution, File Edit Prompts, and Enterprise Login Issues

body.zh-TW:
平時呼叫工具跑指令、想退回工作區外的變更，或是重新啟動後準備上工時，你可能曾碰過莫名報錯或被迫重新登入。

工具呼叫附帶很大的 reasoning signature（推論簽章，模型隨工具呼叫回傳的資料）時，指令以前偶爾無法啟動並回報 `argument list too long`；這個問題已修好。

提示畫面多出一個選項時，例如在接受編輯模式（accept-edits mode）下修改工作區外的檔案，警告標語 `Esc disabled during file edits` 先前會寫錯拒絕鍵的名稱，現在會寫出正確的拒絕鍵。

macOS 與 Windows 上的企業帳號先前若因登入憑證超出系統鑰匙圈的大小上限，重新啟動後登入狀態便會失效；這個問題已經修好，登入狀態現在能在重新啟動後正常延續。
body.en:
When calling tools to execute commands, reverting changes outside your workspace, or preparing to work after a restart, you might have occasionally encountered unexpected errors or forced re-logins.

When tool calls included a large reasoning signature (data returned by models alongside tool calls), commands occasionally failed to launch with `argument list too long`; this issue has been resolved.

When the prompt shows an extra choice, such as for edits outside the workspace in accept-edits mode, the warning banner `Esc disabled during file edits` previously named the wrong reject key; it now names the correct one.

When enterprise accounts on macOS and Windows had login credentials exceeding the system keychain size limit, their login state was previously lost upon restarting; this issue has been resolved, and login status now persists properly across restarts.

items.original:
Fixed terminal commands occasionally failing to start with `argument list too long` when the model returned a very large reasoning signature with the tool call.
Fixed the `Esc disabled during file edits` warning naming the wrong reject key when the prompt shows an extra choice, such as for edits outside the workspace in accept-edits mode.
Fixed sign-in not persisting across restarts on macOS and Windows for enterprise accounts, because the saved credential exceeded the system keychain's size limit.

title.zh-TW: 回覆正文與收合思考區塊空行區隔，頂端僅保留標題
title.en: Blank line separates response text from collapsed thought block, leaving only the header at the top

body.zh-TW: 閱讀代理人剛生成的回覆時，若思考過程與正文擠成一團，往往會打斷閱讀節奏。⟦像在會議中翻閱專案報告，以前草稿筆記直接黏在結論上方容易分散焦點；現在頂端只留一張寫著構思時間的簡潔書籤，中間隔出一行空白，正文一目了然，需要時再翻開整份草稿。⟧現在代理人開始輸出回覆後，收合的思考區塊只會顯示 `Thought for …` 標題，不再重複列出思考過程的文字片段。收合的思考區塊與正文之間也多了一行空行隔開，文字段落不會再擠在一起。如果你想確認剛才完整的推導邏輯，只要手動展開該區塊，依然能查閱完整的思考內容。
body.en: When reading a newly generated response from an agent, having the thought process clustered against the main text often breaks your reading flow. ⟦Picture reviewing a project report during a meeting: previously, draft notes stuck directly above the conclusion would distract focus, whereas now only a neat bookmark noting thinking time remains at the top with a blank line in between, keeping the main text clear at a glance while letting you unfold the full draft whenever needed.⟧ Now, once the agent begins outputting a response, the collapsed thought block only displays the `Thought for …` header instead of repeating text snippets from the thought process. A blank line also separates the collapsed thought block from the main text, so text paragraphs no longer bunch together. If you want to verify the complete reasoning logic behind it, you can still view the full thoughts simply by expanding the block manually.

items.original: Improved how agent responses read: a blank line now separates the collapsed thought block from the response, and once the response starts, the collapsed thought shows only its `Thought for …` header instead of repeating a snippet of the thinking; expand it to see the full thinking.

title.zh-TW: 比對檢視支援折疊搜尋計數，游標樣式與停駐位置對齊
title.en: Diff view supports folded search counts, aligning cursor style and resting position

body.zh-TW: 檢閱程式碼變更時，折疊起來的未更動行數常讓搜尋結果變得難以掌握。⟦好比翻閱厚重的帳冊索引，以前夾在折頁裡的項目算不進筆數，各分冊的標記色塊也不一致；現在標籤直接註記折疊處藏有幾筆帳目，選取欄位也統一換成箭頭符號，翻到當前回合就直接對準第一筆明細。⟧在 `/diff` 檔案檢視中以 `/` 搜尋時，工具現在會計算折疊行內的相符項目，以 `match 2/5 · +3 hidden` 顯示隱藏數量，`f` 鍵展開提示也改為 `show N hidden matches`。介面上，`Commit Tree` 改用與 `All Changes` 及 `Per Turn` 相同的 `>` 游標與選取色，不再用高亮色塊；切換到 `Per Turn` 時游標也會直接停在第一個檔案，不必再跳過回合標題。
body.en: When reviewing code changes, collapsed unchanged lines often make search results hard to track. ⟦Much like browsing a thick ledger index, items tucked inside folded pages were previously excluded from match counts and marker color blocks across volumes were inconsistent, whereas tabs now directly annotate how many entries are hidden in folds, selection columns uniformly switch to arrow symbols, and turning to the current turn lands straight on the first detail.⟧ When searching with `/` inside the `/diff` file view, the tool now counts matches within folded lines, displaying the hidden count as `match 2/5 · +3 hidden`, and the `f` key expand hint is now updated to `show N hidden matches`. On the interface, `Commit Tree` now uses the same `>` cursor and selection color as `All Changes` and `Per Turn` instead of highlight blocks; when switching to `Per Turn`, the cursor also rests directly on the first file without needing to skip past turn headers.

items.original:
Improved `/` search in the `/diff` file view to count matches inside folded unchanged lines, such as `match 2/5 · +3 hidden` or `no matches · +1 hidden`, and the `f` hint now reads `show N hidden matches`.
Improved `/diff`'s `Commit Tree` to mark the selected commit with the same `>` cursor and selection color as `All Changes` and `Per Turn` instead of a highlighted bar, and made `Per Turn` start with the cursor on the first file instead of its turn header.

title.zh-TW: 循環排程引入偏移時間差，避免整點邊界流量暴增
title.en: Recurring schedules introduce time offsets to prevent traffic spikes on hour boundaries

body.zh-TW: 若有多個背景任務排在整點同時啟動，瞬間湧入的連線很容易讓伺服器塞車。⟦跟社區大樓安排住戶分流一樣，以前所有單位全擠在整點出門容易在閘門大塞車；現在為每個單位分配固定的前後時間差，整點前後平順出發，需要分秒不差的專車依然能申請在準點出發。⟧由代理人透過 `schedule` 工具建立的循環 cron 排程，現在觸發時會依每個排程套用固定的偏移時間，不再剛好卡在整點邊界，有效分散尖峰流量。在一天內多次重複的任務（例如每 30 分鐘或每小時一次），會在各自週期內的特定時間點觸發。每天早上 9:00 等固定時間排程，依然會在預定的該分鐘內執行。若排程需要嚴格對準時刻，代理人也能要求精確時間，而 `@every` 間隔排程則維持原樣不變。
body.en: When multiple background tasks are scheduled to launch at the same time on the hour, an instant surge of connections easily congests the server. ⟦Just as a residential complex staggers departures for its tenants, having every household head out right on the hour previously caused massive gate congestion, but assigning a fixed offset window to each unit now smooths out traffic around the hour while reserved shuttles that require exact timing can still request sharp departure times.⟧ Recurring cron schedules created by an agent via the `schedule` tool now apply a fixed offset time to each schedule when triggered, no longer landing exactly on hour boundaries and effectively spreading out peak traffic. Tasks that repeat multiple times throughout the day (such as every 30 minutes or once an hour) trigger at specific points within their respective intervals. Fixed-time schedules like 9:00 AM every morning still execute within their scheduled minute. If a schedule requires strict time alignment, the agent can also request exact timing, while `@every` interval schedules remain unchanged.

items.original: Improved recurring cron schedules created with the agent's `schedule` tool to fire at a consistent per-schedule offset instead of exactly on the cron boundary, to avoid traffic spikes: schedules that repeat within a day, such as every 30 minutes or hourly, now fire somewhere within their period, fixed-time schedules such as daily at 9:00 still fire within their scheduled minute, and the agent can request exact timing when a schedule needs it. `@every` schedules are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 降低閒置與執行資源消耗，長對話與啟動載入更流暢
title.en: Reduced idle and runtime resource consumption with smoother long conversations and startup loading

body.zh-TW:
長時間在終端機開啟工具或處理大型專案時，背景消耗的硬體資源現在明顯下降。

當畫面沒有任何文字變動時，終端機會暫停螢幕重繪，讓閒置時的 CPU 使用率約減少一半。而在模型輸出串流回覆的過程中，工具會略過重複的畫面更新，並降低額度餘額的刷新頻率以節省運算效能。

長篇對話的渲染效能有所改善，重新恢復長對話工作階段時的載入速度也提升。命令列介面啟動並刷新對話摘要時，CPU 開銷也一併降低。

在記憶體管理方面，輸入提示詞與各類文字時改為打字時才動態配置儲存空間，不再預先保留整塊記憶體。閒置時的 CPU 消耗降低，長對話顯示與恢復載入也更快。
body.en:
When keeping the tool open in the terminal for long periods or working on large projects, background hardware resource consumption has now noticeably decreased.

When there are no text changes on screen, the terminal pauses screen repaints, cutting idle CPU usage roughly in half. Meanwhile, while the model streams output, the tool skips redundant screen redraws and lowers the refresh frequency of quota balances to save computing power.

Rendering performance for long conversations has improved, and loading speed when resuming long conversation sessions has also increased. When the command-line interface launches and refreshes conversation summaries, CPU overhead is similarly reduced.

Regarding memory management, storage space for prompt inputs and various texts is now dynamically allocated during typing instead of pre-allocating entire memory blocks. Idle CPU consumption drops, and long conversation display as well as resumption loading become faster.

items.original:
Improved idle CPU usage by pausing screen refreshes while nothing on screen changes, roughly halving the CLI's CPU use when it is idle.
Improved CPU usage while a response streams by skipping redundant screen updates and refreshing the credit balance less often.
Improved rendering speed for long conversations, and made long conversations load faster when you resume them.
Improved startup CPU usage when the CLI refreshes its conversation summaries.
Improved memory usage by allocating storage for the prompt and other text inputs as you type instead of reserving it up front.

title.zh-TW: 模型遭安全機制阻擋時停止無止盡重試
title.en: Stop infinite retries when the model is blocked by safety mechanisms

body.zh-TW: 遇上模型回覆被內容安全過濾機制阻擋的突發狀況，代理人過去容易陷入停不下來的重試迴圈。以前遇到回應被安全過濾器阻擋時，代理人會在背景靜默重試，甚至可能陷入無止盡的重試迴圈；現在這個問題已經修好，遇到阻擋時不再默默持續重試。
body.en: When encountering unexpected situations where a model response was blocked by content safety filters, agents previously tended to get trapped in an endless retry loop. In the past, when a response was blocked by safety filters, the agent would silently retry in the background and could even enter an infinite retry loop; this issue has now been resolved, and it no longer keeps silently retrying when blocked.

items.original: Fixed the agent silently retrying, potentially without end, when a model response was blocked by content safety filters.

title.zh-TW: 外掛設定支援以字串指定技能路徑，避免載入失敗
title.en: Plugin configuration supports specifying skill paths as strings to prevent loading failures

body.zh-TW: 想載入為其他工具設計的外掛程式時，設定檔格式只要稍有不同就會直接報錯。以前如果外掛的 `plugin.json` 將 `skills` 欄位寫成單一路徑字串（例如 `"skills": "./skills/"`）而非陣列清單，外掛就會載入失敗。現在這個問題已經修好，工具能正確辨識單一路徑字串並完成載入。
body.en: When trying to load plugins designed for other tools, any slight difference in configuration format would directly trigger an error. Previously, if a plugin's `plugin.json` specified the `skills` field as a single path string (such as `"skills": "./skills/"`) instead of an array list, the plugin failed to load. This issue has now been resolved, and the tool correctly recognizes a single path string and completes loading.

items.original: Fixed plugins failing to load when `plugin.json` gives `skills` as a single path string, such as `"skills": "./skills/"`, instead of an array, as some plugins written for other tools do.

title.zh-TW: 市集外掛安裝與更新遇網路中斷自動重試一次
title.en: Marketplace plugin installation and updates automatically retry once on network interruption

body.zh-TW: 從市集安裝或自動更新外掛程式時，偶發的網路震盪容易造成程序中斷。以前下載內容短暫過時或下載中斷時，市集外掛安裝與自動更新可能因校驗碼不符或網路錯誤而失敗；現在命令列介面會自動重試下載一次。
body.en: When installing or automatically updating plugins from the marketplace, occasional network disruptions easily interrupted the process. Previously, when downloaded content was temporarily stale or downloads were interrupted, marketplace plugin installations and automatic updates could fail due to checksum mismatches or network errors; the command-line interface now automatically retries the download once.

items.original: Fixed marketplace plugin installs and automatic updates failing with a checksum mismatch or network error when a download was briefly stale or interrupted; the CLI now retries the download once.

title.zh-TW: 已回答的問題之間自動加入空行，精簡模式維持緊湊排版
title.en: Answered questions now automatically include a blank line between them, while compact mode preserves a tight layout

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機連續向 AI 提出多個問題時，畫面上常常累積了長長一串對話紀錄。以前每輪問答緊密相接，文字擠在一起時很難一眼看清每個問題的段落邊界。⟦就像參觀藝廊時欣賞牆上的攝影作品，以前每幅照片緊緊挨著張貼，視線容易把不同主題混成一團；現在每組作品之間留出均勻空隙，瀏覽時就能立刻辨識各個段落的分界。⟧現在終端機處理完提問後，會在各個已回答的問題之間自動加入一行空白行。多了一行留白後，不論前一個問題的回答有多長，你都能一眼找出上一段問答的結尾。唯一的例外是當你開啟精簡模式（`/compact-mode`）時，介面會維持原有的緊湊排版而不加入空行，讓你在高度有限的視窗中能同時看到更多對話內容。
body.en: When you ask an AI multiple questions in a row in the terminal, a long conversation history often accumulates on the screen. Previously, each round of questions and answers sat flush against the next, making it difficult to clearly see the boundaries of each question when the text was packed tightly together. ⟦Picture browsing photography on an art gallery wall: previously, photos hung directly edge to edge, so your eyes could easily blur different themes together; now, even gaps between exhibits let you immediately spot where each section divides.⟧ Now, after the terminal finishes processing your questions, answered questions now have a blank line between them. With this extra blank line, no matter how long the previous answer was, you can easily locate the end of the prior exchange at a glance. The only exception is when you enable compact mode (`/compact-mode`), where the interface maintains its original tight layout without adding blank lines, allowing you to view more conversation content at once in a window with limited height.

items.original: Answered questions now have a blank line between them, except in compact mode (`/compact-mode`)

title.zh-TW: `/plugins` 僅計算成功載入的技能，並標明因外部連結略過的數量
title.en: `/plugins` now counts only plugin skills that load, and indicates how many were skipped because they link outside the plugin folder

body.zh-TW: 想確認外掛擴充功能有沒有正確啟用，最直接的方法就是打 `/plugins` 檢視終端機列出的統計數字。以前統計時可能連同未成功載入的項目一併計算，讓人難以一眼確認哪些技能真正可以使用。現在輸入 `/plugins` 檢視時，工具只會統計成功載入的外掛技能。如果有任何技能因為連結到外掛資料夾外部而被略過，介面也會清楚標示具體略過了多少個項目。看清實際載入的數量，能幫助你立刻掌握外掛規模，並在數字短少時及時檢查檔案路徑。⟦好比運動會檢錄處清點參賽選手，以前名冊上只要有名字就全部算進報到人數，現在裁判只登錄順利踏入指定檢錄區的人員，並在看板寫明有多少人因跑出指定線外而未計入出場名單。⟧
body.en: The most direct way to confirm whether plugin extensions are enabled correctly is to run `/plugins` to check the statistics displayed in the terminal. Previously, tallies might include items that failed to load, making it hard to see at a glance which skills were actually usable. Now when you run `/plugins`, it counts only the plugin skills that load. If any skills are skipped because they link outside the plugin folder, the interface clearly indicates exactly how many items were skipped. Seeing the actual number of loaded skills helps you immediately gauge plugin scale and promptly inspect file paths if counts fall short. ⟦At a sports meet registration desk tallying competitors, officials previously counted every name on the roster toward attendance; now, referees record only athletes who successfully step into the designated check-in area, while posting on the board how many were excluded from the roster for running outside the boundary lines.⟧

items.original: `/plugins` now counts only the plugin skills that load, and says how many were skipped because they link outside the plugin folder

title.zh-TW: 儀表板將位置列整併至邊框，目錄分組新增路徑與代理數量標頭
title.en: Dashboard Merges Location Row into Border, Directory Grouping Adds Path and Agent Count Headers

body.zh-TW: 在終端機開啟儀表板管理多個專案時，查看分支與各目錄代理分布變得十分直覺。⟦如同走進規劃整齊的檔案庫，以前每張桌子都要立一塊大立牌寫專案名稱，現在直接把分處標籤壓印在收件盒上框，每個資料夾分格上方也清楚貼上部門路徑與文件總數。⟧以往顯示所在分支與資料夾的位置資訊會單獨占用一整列標頭，現在這項資訊直接嵌入發送框的頂部邊框，不再浪費額外的版面空間。當儀表板依目錄將代理分組時，每個代理資料夾上方都會標示獨立的標頭，具體列出資料夾路徑以及該資料夾擁有的代理數量。切換視窗時一眼就能掌握所在工作區與代理配置，不必在清單裡費力辨識。
body.en: When opening the dashboard in the terminal to manage multiple projects, checking branches and agent distribution across directories becomes very intuitive. ⟦Think of stepping into an orderly archive: previously, every desk had to erect a large placard displaying the project name, whereas branch labels are now stamped directly onto the inbox's top border, and department paths alongside total document counts are clearly affixed above each folder compartment.⟧ Previously, location information showing the current branch and folder occupied an entire standalone header row, but this information is now embedded directly into the top border of the dispatch box, no longer wasting extra layout space. When the dashboard groups agents by directory, an independent header appears above each agent folder, specifically listing the folder path and the agent count held within that folder. Switching windows lets you grasp the current workspace and agent allocation at a single glance without having to strain to identify them in the list.

items.original:
Dashboard directory grouping now shows a header with the folder path and agent count above each folder of agents
Dashboard location (branch and folder) now sits on the dispatch box top border instead of its own header row

title.zh-TW: 接續工作階段排上歡迎選單首位，儀表板支援跨資料夾恢復進度
title.en: Resume Session Moves to Top of Welcome Menu, Dashboard Supports Resuming Progress Across Folders

body.zh-TW: 中斷開發告一段落後重新啟動 Grok，快速回到前一次的對話往往是第一要務。⟦跟走進工坊重拾手藝一樣，以前工具架總是把全新空白圖紙擺在最顯眼處，想找昨天做到一半的零件得翻遍抽屜；現在半成品直接放在工作檯正中央，跨組件的舊進度也全數排開備查。⟧在歡迎選單中，接續工作階段的選項與快捷鍵 Ctrl+R 調整至首位。原本排在最上方的新增工作樹（Git 讓專案平行建立多份副本的功能）與快捷鍵 Ctrl+W 則順延至其後。在儀表板執行 /resume 指令時，清單會完整列出所有資料夾的工作階段，不再受限於單一目錄。目前所在的資料夾與其簽出項目會排在最前面，方便你優先接續當前專案的進度。
